The '''Bluestone District''' was a district in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ussa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. Like the other districts in the city, its name came from the [[Bluestone Lake|lake]] that it contained. Given its central location, much of Ussa's traffic, both motorized and pedestrian, moved through the Bluestone district. The district was adjacent to [[Cloud Lake District]] and [[The Commons]].
